name: scd41_module
title: SCD41 module
description: A small blue board with the sensor, two resistors and a capacitor, and four holes, as AliExpress sells it
notes: No regulator on the top side: VDD goes to the sensor, which draws up to 205 mA at 3.3 V for a moment (datasheet, Table 4).

aliexpress.source: Anton bought an SCD41 on AliExpress for about 15 to 17 EUR

listing.source: Photos of the board Anton sent: the blue one is the SCD41. Holes GND (the square one), VDD, SCL, SDA; R1 at SDA, R2 at SCL, C1. logic VDD assumes that R1 and R2 pull the lines up to VDD: not measured

supply.source: CD_DS_SCD4x_Datasheet_D1.pdf in esp32-component-scd4x, Table 4: VDD 2.4 to 5.5 V; SDA and SCL at most VDD + 0.3 V
